svg.title: Pigeon system architecture
svg.desc: Hand-drawn layered diagram: clients reach Caddy, which proxies to the Next.js frontend and admin panel and to the FastAPI backend, which talks to MongoDB across two logical databases. Nine asyncio background loops and a system_jobs queue run in the API process, and external integrations branch off to the side.
svg.text: open-source cold email outreach + deliverability platform · a DevsBazaar product
on_demand_tls issues certs for customer tracking domains; the ask endpoint is /api/tracking/verify-host
~58k LOC · uvicorn · single ASGI app, everything mounted under the /api prefix
MongoDB — one cluster, two logical databases
mongo:7 in docker compose for self-hosting; MONGO_URL points at a managed cluster (e.g. Atlas) in production
144 create_index() calls run in the FastAPI lifespan startup hook, alongside three idempotent data migrations.
called out from the API process
server-side only; keys from env or per-user encrypted settings
atomic claim + heartbeat · Semaphore(20) · drains on ASG terminate
